theorems.name: Submission.lpf_c1r_uniform_remainder
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (g : Eucl n → ℝ) (K : ℝ≥0), LipschitzWith K g → ∀ C : Set (Eucl n), IsClosed C → (∀ x ∈ C, DifferentiableAt ℝ g x) → ContinuousOn (fderiv ℝ g) C → ∀ ε : ℝ≥0∞, 0 < ε → ∃ A : Set (Eucl n), IsClosed A ∧ A ⊆ C ∧ (volume : Measure (Eucl n)) (C \ A) < ε ∧ ∀ L : Set (Eucl n), IsCompact L → L ⊆ A → ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ ∀ x ∈ L, ∀ y ∈ A, dist x y < ρ → ‖g y - g x - fderiv ℝ g x (y - x)‖ ≤ δ * ‖y - x‖
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
